text.tspan: LAN, WLAN, WAN and the internet in one small company
LAN / WLAN: desks on cables, laptops on Wi-Fi, all through the switch · Internet: customers reach the load balancer
WAN: the office reaches the database privately over the VPN · Client–server everywhere: browser → LB → app → DB
